boards.name: ESP32-C6 SuperMini (4 MB)
boards.notes: LED driver on GPIO2, button on GPIO3. Matter over Thread, product ID 0x8001.

boards.name: Seeed XIAO ESP32-C6
boards.notes: Needs its own build: button on GPIO1 (D1), GPIO3 drives the antenna switch.

boards.name: ESP32-H2 boards
boards.notes: Thread and Bluetooth, no Wi-Fi. Needs its own build and pin choice.

boards.name: ESP32-C3 / ESP32-S3 boards
boards.notes: No Thread radio: would need a Matter over Wi-Fi firmware, a different product line.

boards.name: Seeed XIAO MG24
boards.notes: Not an Espressif chip: needs different firmware and a different flashing method.

boards.name: Seeed XIAO nRF52840
boards.notes: Not an Espressif chip: needs different firmware and a different flashing method.
